services.desc: Email ed@tranzac.org with the subject line RENTALS COORDINATOR APPLICATION - YOUR NAME. The Rentals Coordinator at Tranzac plays a key role in facilitating the daytime and evening rentals for our three rooms, ensuring smooth operation and high customer satisfaction for our multi-use performing arts facility. This role involves significant customer interaction, operational coordination, and active outreach to maintain and establish new rental relationships. To apply, email ed@tranzac.org with the subject line RENTALS COORDINATOR APPLICATION - YOUR NAME. Please send your cover letter and resume together as one PDF.
